title: Adorable Tiny Home in the Middle of Music City
description:
"This is hands down the best Nashville Airbnb I've stayed in, out of 20 plus Airbnb's. This place felt like home. Easy parking, love the high ceilings, makes it feel a lot bigger" said a recent guest. Self check in, free parking by the front door, WiFi,  private entrance, patio, kitchenette, large shower, work space.  Only 3 miles miles from Broadway, very desirable neighborhood, near Vanderbilt, Belmont, great restaurants! The perfect spot in the middle of everything Nashville has to offer!

The space
One large 400 square foot room with high studio ceiling, sitting area, kitchenette, Queen bed with Puffy mattress, full bath with large shower, table for eating in, or working online, and a large closet for storing luggage and clothes.  Private patio outside front door.

Guest access
Free parking for 2 vehicles on the left side of the house.  Sidewalks are available for walking to Vanderbilt, Hillsboro Village, Kroger grocery store, and around the neighborhood.

Other things to note
After booking you'll receive a code to enter the house.

My wife, Beth and I have lived next door to our Airbnb, which we had built in 2021, since 1988. We love Nashville and our neighborhood! It's a safe area near Vanderbilt University, and convenient to everything Nashville has to offer!  There are sidewalks throughout, and a cool neighborhood bar and grill, within walking distance, called Brown's Diner! Browns Diner serves breakfast, lunch and dinner, 7 days a week!  Have a great stay in Music City!
